Off. Pressing Home opens the TV\'s usual home screen.

To make the Home button open TunaHome:

1. Open accessibility settings.
2. Choose TunaHome.
3. Switch it on.

If another launcher already takes over the Home button, switch that off first.

To undo this, switch TunaHome off on the same screen.
The Home button opens TunaHome.\n\nTo go back to the TV\'s usual home screen, open accessibility settings, choose TunaHome and switch it off.

Opens TunaHome when you press Home.

Lets TunaHome open when you press the Home button. It only watches for the Home button and for the TV\'s own home screen appearing. It cannot read what is on screen and sends nothing anywhere. Switch it off to return to the TV\'s usual home screen.
